angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 203,979 km at 44.73 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 22.3572 +/- 0.0308 mas (same row, RUWE 1.30): 44.73 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.2932 +/- 0.0093 solar radii from Stefansson et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-25 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..192S/abstract): 203,979 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.2634 +/- 0.0077 solar masses from Stefansson et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-25 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..192S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3207 +/- 58 K from Stefansson et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-25 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..192S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stefansson et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-25 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..192S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-25.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.924, rounded to two decimals

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, coloured from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
